title: Review of c15's outside-slow ringless twin: replicated on fresh seeds 11 and 13 (16 and 11 persistent splits, generation 3 and 4, against 15 and 10 for the ringed world on the same seeds) with lower interior fuel (0.44 vs 0.58-0.64)
summary: c15's world.py with WORLD_P {"chis":0,"dout":0.1} (no ring; fuel diffusivity Df inside rods, 10x lower in the bath), on fresh seeds 11 and 13, 128^2, T=1000 (outslow/). Ringless (0% of 172 and 125 body-frames ring-like), interior fuel 0.444 and 0.438 (ringstat_outslow.txt), and the colony divides as much as the ringed world: 16 persistent splits, generation 3 (seed 11) and 11, generation 4 (seed 13), against 15 (generation 3) and 10 (generation 3) for the ringed world on the same seeds, and 10 (generation 3) for the ring-off twin on seed 11 (my 20261025T1425-c19-review-fuelcell). Rods form from noise and divide as in the ringed world (outslow/seed13/sheet.png). This confirms the finding on two more seeds: the ring's division gain is reproduced by a slow exterior with no ring, at lower core fuel. Note for re-users: the published world.py defaults to the ringed world (chis 3, dout 0); run with the defaults it reproduces the ringed world exactly (defaults/: 15 and 10 splits, 100% ringed, ringstat_defaults.txt), and the twin needs the WORLD_P above, which the pack's FACTS.md does not record.

observations.finding: ringstat_outslow.txt: outside-slow twin 16/11 persistent splits, generation 3/4, core fuel 0.444/0.438, 0% ringed on seeds 11/13; ringed world on the same seeds 15/10, generation 3/3, core fuel 0.580/0.640 (ringstat_defaults.txt)

seeds_run.result: pass: 16 vs 15 splits with no ring
pass: 11 vs 10 splits with no ring, generation 4

controls_run.finding: defaults/seed11, defaults/seed13: the ringed world (same file, default parameters), same seeds

verdicts.limitation: One exterior factor (10x) and two seeds; as the finding notes, the slow bath also slows fuel spreading before rods form. Split counts vary 2-3x between seeds, so 'matches' means within that noise. Motility stays weak (3.3-3.6 body lengths).
